messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (model-runner) detected by synthetic checks. 5xx spike from 0.3% -> 12% in the last 3m. Paging oncall (sofia).
sofia (oncall): ack. I'm seeing the alert, pulling up logs. @raj can you join? I'm starting an incident thread.
raj (sre): on it. looking at prometheus dashboards — error_budget burn on p50/p95 tokens. cpu/gpu util seems normal but error traces show repeated `SIGSEGV` and `oom-kill` entries from model-runner pods.
maria (ml): which model(s)? this might be the new 7B-quant rollout we started at 09:15 UTC.
sofia (oncall): yes rollout of 7b-quant-2026-03-14. Canary group shows most failures. root logs:
```
model-runner[pid=2321]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7fabcd12345 sp 0x7ffd... error 4 in libattention.so
kernel: Killed process 2321 (model-runner) total-vm:2048000kB, anon-rss:1890000kB, file-rss:0kB
```
sofia (oncall): pattern: model-runner process crashing -> k8s restarts -> 502/5xx to clients. impact: hosted API and some dedicated pools using the same variant.
dave (infra): check node-level oom? `kubectl describe pod` shows `OOMKilled` and `Container cannot run` intermittently. Node memory headroom low on node-group-gpu-2. Possibly memory leak or kernel-level issue with the quantized kernel.
raj (sre): mitigation plan: 1) stop rollout, 2) scale canary replicas to 0 for 7b-quant, 3) revert traffic to previous stable model 7b-v1, 4) drain affected pods, 5) if needed, cordon nodes so no new canaries land.
sofia (oncall): doing step 1+2 now. @maria can you confirm a revert artifact exists and whether it's compatible with the routing policy?
maria (ml): yes 7b-v1 stable is available and matches iface/kv-cache. Initiating route rollback in feature-gates: setting route weight 0->stable 100. Command I ran:
```
redwoodctl routes set-weight --route /v1/generate --model 7b-quant-2026-03-14=0 --model 7b-v1=100
```
sofia (oncall): applying scale down for canary: `kubectl scale deployment/runner-7b-quant --replicas=0 -n inference` — done. pods terminating.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Route rollback applied; RRID 8a3f. Canary replicas scaled to 0.
raj (sre): good. now we need to mitigate existing restarts and free node memory. dave, can you coordinate cordon/drain for nodes with many OOMs?
dave (infra): cordoning node gpu-2-14 and draining. moving unaffected workloads to gpu-2-10/11. Also increasing GPU node pool autoscaler to +3 temporarily.
sofia (oncall): enabling fallback route for any remaining traffic to cpu-backed runner (slower but stable):
```
redwoodctl routes add-fallback --route /v1/generate --model runner-cpu-small --priority 10
```
sofia (oncall): fallback enabled. telling customer-success to alert critical customers.
customer-success: notifying enterprise customers who recently hit errors; posting status on status.redwood.ai
customer-success: message sent to customers affected by 5xx. shared temporary mitigation: rollback + fallback. asking for any customer-specific P0 issues.
raj (sre): monitoring logs. error rate dropped from 12% -> 1.4% after rollback+fallback. still seeing occasional segfaults in older pods; they should be terminating.
maria (ml): I'll open a rollback PR to the model catalog and notify model owners. Also start a bisect on the quant kernels against a dev rig to reproduce segfault.
sofia (oncall): handing off to raj for deeper debugging and postmortem. I'm switching to incident-management channel to assemble postmortem. @raj you own next 2hr on-call.
raj (sre): taking over. immediate next steps: collect core dumps, `kubectl logs --previous` for crashed containers, get `dmesg` from nodes, preserve affected nodes with `kubectl label node preserve-incident=1770123456` to prevent autoscaler churn.
sofia (oncall): done, added label and snapshot of node images. Also recording customer impact: hosted API saw ~8% of requests 5xx globally between 09:15-09:48 UTC; hit ~2 enterprise customers with sustained failures — customer-success initiated support calls.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-14-91 assigned to raj (sre). Pagerduty notified.
pagerduty: paging raj (sre) — acknowledge required.
raj (sre): acked PD. starting full forensic capture now. Commands I ran:
```
kubectl exec -n inference runner-7b-quant-abc -- gcore -o /tmp/core || true
kubectl get events --field-selector reason=OOMKilled -n inference > /tmp/oom-events.log
```
raj (sre): preliminary hypothesis: quantized attention kernel introduced a memory-safety regression when run on CUDA driver 525.x on these node images. Repro locally on dev-gpu-3 shows segfault after ~1.7B tokens.
dave (infra): isolating node image versions, will pin affected pools to previous driver (524.x) until we have a fix. rolling back node image is slow; instead will schedule canaries to nodes with older driver.
maria (ml): will revert the quantized kernel patch and run CI-heavy memory tests. Also will add a runtime guard to disable advanced kernel selection on this model variant until validated.
raj (sre): adding action items to incident: preserve cores, rollback model patch in catalog, revert node driver upgrade or pin scheduling, postmortem owner = raj + maria, target P1 postmortem in 48h.
sofia (oncall): thanks team. I'm closing the active paging rotation. leaving the incident open for postmortem and follow ups. any other customer impacts to report?
customer-success: we have 2 support cases in flight; status updated. customers appreciative of quick rollback.
raj (sre): error rate now ~0.2% baseline. I'll keep monitoring for 2 hours and then update incident timeline.
sofia (oncall): :thumbsup: great work. follow-up: create a test that runs 24h token-heavy workloads on quantized kernels in CI and add to pre-rollout gating. maria can you own that?
maria (ml): yes — I'll add a daily long-tail CI and add kernel-sanity test to model onboarding.
sofia (oncall): logging closure note here, handoff complete. Incident channel will have postmortem link when available. :shipit:
